approved: Superannuation (Excess Non-concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

Moved the Superannuation (Excess Non-Concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the tax rate on excess non-concessional contributions rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, with revenue supporting DisabilityCare Australia.

Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
Superannuation (Excess Non-concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Act 2013
